checks.message: Three required key areas are provisional polygons inside the site boundary; not overlapping; full disclosure.
24 grid cells fully cover the site boundary; no gaps, no overlaps; topological safety verified by spatial_review.
Static HTML visualization has no remote scripts, fonts, APIs, iframes, or trackers; required markers and metrics embedded.
V2 bilingual contract satisfied: proposal.md (zh, primary) + proposal.en.md (translation_of=proposal.md); report HTML and figures have .en counterparts.
5 mandatory standards, 15 design-depth items, 23 task requirements, and 27 known metrics are covered; proposal text references every item.
All recomputed metrics (site_area_sqm, green_space_area_sqm, public_space_area_sqm, building_footprint_area_sqm, green_ratio, public_space_ratio) match spatial_review output within tolerance.
Both drawing PDFs are generated with multi-page content (A3 booklet with five panels and A0 boards with five panels) and are no longer the empty placeholder.
AI generation model (deepseek, DeepSeek V4 Flash via WorkBuddy), generation method, and human-review checkpoints are disclosed in agent.json and copyright statement.
Jing-Zhang railway heritage (Tsinghuayuan station provisional callout) protected via constraints layer and dedicated strategy in proposal.md Section 9; no fabrication of official heritage control.
